parallels.note: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

people.name: Eber
people.line: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan

people.name: Shelah
people.line: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Shelah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
